title: 听力挑战 · 数据讨论会

rounds.speaker: 主持人
rounds.line: As the chart illustrates, the sales figures rose steadily from January to June before leveling off in July.
rounds.lineCn: 如图表所示,销售额从一月到六月稳步上升,七月开始趋于平稳。

grammar.name: 趋势描述:上升后持平
grammar.note: rise steadily 表稳步上升,level off 表趋于平稳;As the chart illustrates 是图表引入标准句式。

options.text: Sales climbed steadily and then stabilized in July.
options.feedback: 销售额稳步上升,七月趋于平稳。

options.text: Sales fell sharply throughout the whole year.
options.feedback: 图中是上升走势,并非全年大跌。

options.text: Sales remained completely flat from January onward.
options.feedback: 一月到六月在稳步上升,并非一直持平。

rounds.speaker: 分析员
rounds.line: The percentage of renewable energy reached its peak in 2024, accounting for nearly forty percent of the total.
rounds.lineCn: 可再生能源占比在 2024 年达到峰值,约占总量百分之四十。

grammar.name: 峰值描述 + 补充说明
grammar.note: reach its peak 表达到峰值;accounting for 表占比,是图表数据描述的核心动词搭配。

options.text: Renewable energy peaked at about forty percent in 2024.
options.feedback: 可再生能源占比 2024 年峰值约四成。

options.text: Renewable energy was at its lowest point in 2024.
options.feedback: 2024 年恰好是峰值,而非低谷。

options.text: Renewable energy never approached forty percent.
options.feedback: 数据显示占比已接近百分之四十。

rounds.speaker: 分析员
rounds.line: By contrast, the number of participants fell dramatically during the third quarter and then recovered slightly.
rounds.lineCn: 相比之下,参与者数量在第三季度急剧下降,随后略有回升。

grammar.name: 对比与波动描述
grammar.note: By contrast 引出对比;fall dramatically 急剧下降,recover slightly 略有回升,动词+副词是图表语言精髓。

options.text: Participant numbers dropped sharply and then recovered a little.
options.feedback: 三季度骤降后小幅回升,正是原句含义。

options.text: Participant numbers rose sharply for the whole year.
options.feedback: 原文是下降后再回升,并非全年上升。

options.text: Participant numbers stayed completely stable all year.
options.feedback: 数据出现了明显下降与回升,并非稳定。

rounds.speaker: 主持人
rounds.line: It is evident from the table that production costs declined steadily while consumer demand continued to grow.
rounds.lineCn: 从表格可以明显看出,生产成本稳步下降,而消费需求持续增长。

grammar.name: 对比关系描述
grammar.note: It is evident from... that... 是数据引入句式;while 表示对比:成本降、需求增。

options.text: Costs declined while consumer demand kept rising.
options.feedback: 成本下降与需求上升形成对比。

options.text: Costs and consumer demand both declined together.
options.feedback: 成本在降,需求却持续增长。

options.text: Costs rose at the same rate as consumer demand.

rounds.speaker: 主持人
rounds.line: Overall, the data suggest a positive trend, although fluctuations remain possible in the coming months.
rounds.lineCn: 总体而言,数据表明趋势向好,尽管未来几个月仍可能出现波动。

grammar.name: 总结趋势 + 保留余地
grammar.note: Overall 总起,suggest a positive trend 归纳趋势,although 让步保留波动风险,体现结论的严谨性。

options.text: The overall trend is positive, though fluctuations are possible.
options.feedback: 总体向好,但未来仍有波动可能。

options.text: The overall trend is clearly negative and worsening.
options.feedback: 数据显示的是积极趋势。

options.text: The data show no meaningful trend at all.
options.feedback: 数据明确显示出积极趋势。
